title: Valantic bought its way into an OutSystems Elite practice in Nov-2022, filling its low-code slot
content:
Valantic's tool field records how its low-code capability was obtained: it acquired Do iT Lean, a Portuguese OutSystems Elite and Premier partner, in November 2022. SAP sits alongside, against banking, manufacturing and retail verticals.

Acquiring a partner is a materially stronger commitment than holding a badge. A partner tier can be dropped when it stops paying; an acquired practice is on the balance sheet, with staff, references and an integration to justify. For a rescore that reads slot occupancy, this is occupancy that was paid for deliberately.

It is the sharpest instance of a pattern running through the tier-9 rows — Conclusion on Mendix and OutSystems, NTT Data Spain on OutSystems in five countries, Valcon on Appian and Mendix. Proprietary low-code occupies the slot a Powerhouse build would target in each of them, which means the competitor in these accounts is not an incumbent workflow tool but an existing revenue line the firm chose to buy. The row remains a mechanically rescored v2 entry with an OSS-portfolio screen outstanding.
